registerAccess: Full 16-page PDF text read through web tool, including all seven descriptions. Original PDF bytes unavailable; processed tool capture staged.
scope: One ensemble of seven houses at Roemer Visscherstraat 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30 and 30A. Maintain the gently curved frontage and individually distinct crowns.

architecturalEvidence.assertion: Red brick; gothic glazing, a two-storey timber bay and an oriel with onion cap distinguish Germany.
White three-sided projecting front, pilasters, French balconies and a steep shingled crown distinguish France.
White/pink bands, horseshoe arches, a balcony and a right-hand tower distinguish Spain.
Pink rusticated front, strong horizontal cornices, a semicircular balcony and crown ornaments distinguish Italy.
Yellow brick/stucco front, ogee arches and an octagonal onion tower distinguish Russia.
Brick stepped gable, pale bands, shutters and a central sundial distinguish the Netherlands.
Brick front, crenellated bay, timber projecting gable and intersecting gable roof distinguish England.
